chunks: And ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام that he said:
There is no harm in leaving the Jumuʿah prayer in the rain.

key_terms.الْمَطَرِ: rain, as a cause of hardship and a legal excuse
key_terms.تَدَعَ: to leave or refrain from attending
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to miss Jumuʿah prayer because of rain?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal concession regarding attendance at Jumuʿah prayer when there is rain. It indicates that rainfall constitutes a valid excuse for not attending, reflecting ease and the removal of hardship in Islamic law.
